qualification: Published supplier policy, recorded capabilities and limitations only; no unpublished Native source consumed.

request.canonicalTargetNames: A target name must be a portable relative path whose normalized form is the text itself: no '.' segment, no leading './', no doubled separator, no '..', no backslash, drive letter or absolute path. The literal text is the manifest key and the materialized relative name, so a differently normalized spelling can never freeze a manifest the run cannot satisfy.
request.reservedTargetNames: A name whose first segment is input, execution or evidence, or whose whole name is request.json, is refused in every spelling because that path is a protocol output of the run, not target input.
request.uncommittedFiles: All selected synthetic fixture files with their exact hashes; no Git worktree discovery claim.

round.enforcement: per-request metadata only; no persistent round counter

operations.begin: Fresh disjoint source/run; materialize copies and verify target before/after copying.
operations.write_generated: Create new files only under execution/generated/; never overwrite.
operations.finalize: Validate target, policy and reviewer result; reviewer role only, exclusive receipt creation.
operations.verify_receipt: Require trusted request/receipt digests and current writer source/base/head; reject any binding drift.

failure.existingEvidence: Never rewritten or removed by API; partial new runs retained on I/O failure.

reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: invalid_relative_name: A target or generated name is empty, absolute, or contains '..', a backslash or a drive letter.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: non_canonical_relative_n: The name is not its own normalized form, so it would freeze a manifest key that differs from the materialized file.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: protocol_output_is_not_t: The name addresses the run's own input/execution/evidence/request.json protocol namespace.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: output_exists_or_overlap: The run directory exists or the run and source roots overlap.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: empty_or_duplicate_targe: No target file, or the same canonical target name twice.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: invalid_round_or_revisio: Round is not an integer in 1..3, or base/head is not a 40-character lowercase revision.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: identity_missing_or_inva: An actor identity is not exactly sessionId/provider/model with non-empty string values.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: reviewer_not_independent: Reviewer and author share a session or a provider.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: model_outside_scope: The policy denies the reviewer's provider/model for the independent-reviewer role.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: supplier_policy_drift: The published M0-03/M1-02 profile, allowlist or receipt no longer recomputes.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: linked_or_network_path: A source, run or copied path is reached through a link; callers must pass a real root.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: target_bytes_changed: A materialized or current writer target file no longer matches the frozen manifest.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: undeclared_target_file: A file under input/ or execution/ is not in the frozen target manifest.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: request_digest_changed: The trusted request digest no longer matches request.json.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: policy_or_scope_changed: The request scope or policy hash no longer matches the live policy.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: current_writer_target_ch: The current writer source or refs no longer reproduce the reviewed target.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: receipt_digest_changed: The trusted receipt digest no longer matches evidence/receipt.json.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: receipt_binding_changed: The receipt no longer binds the request digest, target digest, reviewer or scope.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: receipt_already_exists: A receipt already exists; results are append-only and never overwritten.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: writer_cannot_finalize: Only the independent-reviewer role may write the result.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: generated_output_exists: A generated execution file already exists and is never overwritten.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: write_outside_generated_: Execution writes are limited to new files under execution/generated/.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: result_schema_mismatch: The reviewer result has no exact outcome/actionable/notes shape or a known outcome.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: finding_schema_mismatch: An actionable finding is missing a required non-empty field or locations.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: findings_cannot_be_appro: An approved outcome carried actionable findings.
reasonCodes.cannot_proceed: invalid_or_inaccessible_: Catch-all for an unreadable or non-materialized fixture input.

supplierCapabilities.note: anonymous capability facts only; no hostname, account, path or interpreter build string

limitations: Trusted fixture role/provider/ref inputs are not authenticated identities.
OS sandbox/ACL and direct writer filesystem denial are not implemented or validated.
Trusted external digest custody and exclusively owned local parents are required; no hostile race protection.
Actual independent review, three-perspective aggregation, retry/fallback enforcement and acceptance are not performed.
Synthetic success is not source qualification, product approval or operational permission.

The M1-02 link guard refuses any root reached through a link, so callers must pass a real path; a host temporary directory reached through a system alias must be resolved before it is handed to this API.
